items.title: AlphaGenome 2 listed on DeepMind blog (Science category)
items.summary_en: DeepMind's blog index lists a November 2026 Science post titled 'AlphaGenome 2', about deciphering how cells read DNA to better understand disease. Only the index title and tag were visible in a search snippet; the post body was not read. SiliconANGLE reportedly covered it as a model for predicting how DNA sequence variants affect cell types.

items.notes: deepmind.google could not be fetched (host blocked in this session), so this comes from a search-result snippet of the official index. The exact day is unknown and only the month is given. Technical claims are not verified against the post itself.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5 reported as released
items.summary_en: Secondary reports say DeepMind released Gemini Robotics 2.5, described as its most capable vision-language-action model so far. One report cites 30% to 100% higher success rates than prior baselines across 200 manipulation tasks, and testing on Mercedes-Benz assembly lines with Apptronik. The reports disagree on whether the date is Nov. 10 or Nov. 11.
items.source_name: Silicon Report (secondary; no official DeepMind page read)
items.notes: No primary DeepMind page was accessed. The date is approximate (Nov 10-11) and the name and figures are unverified. A SiliconANGLE report (https://siliconangle.com/?p=853854) was also returned by search. Confirm on the official blog before use.
